title: Mitchell to Acquire Integrated Prescription Solutions
主要内容: Mitchell International announced the acquisition of Integrated Prescription Solutions, a pharmacy benefit management (PBM) company for the workers' compensation industry. The acquisition strengthens Mitchell's ScriptAdvisor™ PBM solution and adds over 70 new customers. Integrated Prescription Solutions' specialty offerings will be integrated into Mitchell's Script, expanding its full end-to-end pharmacy benefit management solution for insurers, third party administrators, self-insured entities, and state funds. The acquisition aims to enhance customer outcomes and build on existing services. Integrated Prescription Solutions offers customizable first fill programs, out-of-network bill processing, electronic claims processing, and durable medical equipment services. Mitchell International, based in San Diego, is celebrating its 70th anniversary of enabling better business outcomes for its customers.
